evidence.expected: Add the release SDK and generated game/component scaffold
evidence.actual: Source, Game.sln, Game.vcxproj, Build.ps1, Project.code.json and candidate build directory were created

evidence.expected: Build candidate, validate startup and activate the custom Game
evidence.actual: Final build 039df3748af84482bb5a7b3301b68f50 validated and activated

evidence.action: Selected annotated TiredBomber.Game via generated catalog/default; launched game and editor smoke

evidence.action: Query same vertical ray with channels 1 and 2
evidence.expected: Default floor responds to channel 1; unit set to channel 2 responds to channel 2

evidence.action: Call DebugDrawTrace(ray,result,0.15f) on each bomb query and inspect hit dump

evidence.action: Create floor-adjacent runtime components, bomb and particles; remove bomb and expire particles

evidence.expected: Compare shadow distance/cache behavior

evidence.action: Changed valid ProjectGame.cpp, injected IntentionalBuildFailure.cpp, ran SDK Build, compared active DLL hash/path, removed bad file and rebuilt
evidence.expected: Failed candidate does not replace the previously validated module; deleting error permits a later build
evidence.actual: C4430/C2146 rejected the invalid file; Project.json.module remained Binaries/Release/90ac519f641e40438e0299383bbbb907/Game.dll and hash was identical; after removing file, build activated 946e31ea4b01407fa71cedb6542c0565/Game.dll.

evidence.action: ProjectTools AddClass -Name FeatureProbeComponent -Kind Component -Base ProjectComponent -BaseHeader ProjectComponent.h, then Release Build
evidence.expected: Create new component subclass with immediate parent calls and catalog registration
evidence.actual: Wizard generated header and cpp with ProjectComponent::BeginPlay/Tick calls; build passed with ComponentGenerator count 5.

evidence.action: Observed project-module startup binding and used EngineModuleVfs::Resolve on the copy scene; also read host-generated shader through VFS
evidence.expected: Obtain host services through broker and use project/engine VFS paths
evidence.actual: SceneModule adapter queried ENGINE_SERVICE_VFS v1 and bound the host VFS. Game-side EngineModuleVfs resolved/read /Game/Scenes/Main.scene.json (1692 bytes); runtime also read /Engine shader. No direct Game-level host context/getService or generic GetCapabilities accessor exists in the public Game API, so that surface remains an adapter-only capability.

evidence.action: Read-only inspect of qt-crash-stack-scan.log and CodeTools/MainWindow Qt patterns
evidence.expected: Identify likely safe UI mitigation without editing Engine
evidence.actual: Partial frames show QAction activate → menu triggered → RunCodeTool → root QWidget::setEnabled(false) → recursive setEnabled_helper → QMenu::changeEvent → QAction::setEnabled fault. QObject parent ownership observed; no proven dangling action. Recommend sceneBusy plus targeted scene-action gating, avoid root disable.
evidence.notes: Diagnosis only, partial unwind; no repro or engine edits by role 3.

evidence.action: Runtime launch using project startupScene manifest
evidence.expected: Load configured Main scene and start project Game
evidence.actual: Project.json startupScene is Content/Scenes/Main.scene.json; runtime log records GameSceneLoaded, GameStart, scene ready: Main, and GetSubsystem after startup=available.
evidence.notes: Runtime-attempt-09 is a real launch log. Final smoke log files are empty and were not used.

evidence.action: Actual GameSession scene lifecycle probe across two scenes
evidence.expected: Subsystem persists across scene replacement and receives lifecycle/tick notifications
evidence.actual: Probe log: initialized; SceneReady First; SceneClosing First; SceneReady Second; same=1 ticks=1 ready=2 closed=1 persisted=1; SceneClosing Second.
evidence.notes: This adds subsystem lifecycle coverage alongside the already recorded session feature.

evidence.action: Add player local-position log every one second for parent UI input run
evidence.expected: W/D movement yields changed x/z and B requests bomb drop
evidence.actual: Player-position sampling added and main project Release module build succeeded; no input press/runtime window run by role 3. B subscriber remains present and should print its request event.
evidence.notes: Initial position (-10,0.5,5), white square in saved dump; B listener already logs request. Does not claim keyboard input passed.
